# FarmHand robot — Phase 1 torque pass (generated by `design/phase1_torque_pass.py`)

Rules: hold ≤ 50 % of rating, move ≤ 70 %. Stepper capacity = holding torque × 50% (ASSUMED 24 V pull-out at working speed) × ratio × efficiency.

Inputs: payload 1.5 kg (1.2 kg spool + 0.3 kg tool); H2S plate steel 486 g (computed, weigh it) + parts 0.5 kg (assumed).

| Architecture | Joint | Case | Need (N·m) | Capacity (N·m) | % | Rule | Verdict | Drive |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A fixed 6-axis (base between printers) | J2 shoulder | 1.5 kg at 0.65 m, hold | 23.51 | 39.0 | 60 % | hold ≤50 % | FAIL | NEMA 23 + HHT-25-50 strain wave + brake |
| A fixed 6-axis (base between printers) | J2 shoulder | same, moving (x1.3) | 30.56 | 39.0 | 78 % | move ≤70 % | FAIL |  |
| A fixed 6-axis (base between printers) | J3 elbow | hold | 8.84 | 30.0 | 29 % | hold ≤50 % | OK | NEMA 23 + EG23 20:1 (20 arcmin needs output encoder) + brake |
| A fixed 6-axis (base between printers) | J3 elbow | moving (x1.3) | 11.50 | 30.0 | 38 % | move ≤70 % | OK |  |
| A fixed 6-axis (base between printers) | J5 wrist pitch | H2S plate + parts held by front edge | 1.94 | 5.4 | 36 % | hold ≤50 % | OK | NEMA 17 + HHT-14-50 + brake |
| B 6-axis on rail | J2 shoulder | 1.5 kg at 0.45 m, hold | 14.62 | 39.0 | 37 % | hold ≤50 % | OK | NEMA 23 + HHT-25-50 strain wave + brake |
| B 6-axis on rail | J2 shoulder | same, moving (x1.3) | 19.01 | 39.0 | 49 % | move ≤70 % | OK |  |
| B 6-axis on rail | J3 elbow | hold | 5.53 | 30.0 | 18 % | hold ≤50 % | OK | NEMA 23 + EG23 20:1 (20 arcmin needs output encoder) + brake |
| B 6-axis on rail | J3 elbow | moving (x1.3) | 7.19 | 30.0 | 24 % | move ≤70 % | OK |  |
| B 6-axis on rail | J5 wrist pitch | H2S plate + parts held by front edge | 1.94 | 5.4 | 36 % | hold ≤50 % | OK | NEMA 17 + HHT-14-50 + brake |
| D rail-SCARA | J1 shoulder (vertical axis) | 1.5 kg at 0.61 m, 180 deg in 1.5 s | 4.97 | 13.5 | 37 % | move ≤70 % | OK | NEMA 23 closed loop + 2-stage HTD belt 1:10 + 14-bit output encoder |
| D rail-SCARA | J1 shoulder (vertical axis) | gravity hold | 0.00 | 13.5 | 0 % | hold ≤50 % | OK | vertical axis: gravity goes into the bearing, not the motor |
| D rail-SCARA | J2 elbow (vertical axis) | 1.5 kg, 180 deg in 1.2 s | 1.87 | 8.1 | 23 % | move ≤70 % | OK | NEMA 23 mounted at J1 (keeps J1 inertia low), belt up the upper arm 1:6 |
| D rail-SCARA | W wrist yaw | H2S plate + parts, 90 deg in 0.8 s | 0.49 | 1.1 | 44 % | move ≤70 % | OK | NEMA 17 closed loop + belt 1:4 |
| D rail-SCARA | Z lift (ball screw 5 mm lead) | 6.45 kg moving up at 1.5 m/s^2 | 0.16 | 1.5 | 11 % | move ≤70 % | OK | NEMA 23 closed loop + SFU1605 + 24 V power-off brake (screw back-drives) |
| D rail-SCARA | Z lift | power off: brake holds, motor 0 % | 0.05 | 1.0 | 5 % | hold ≤50 % | OK | vs a 1.0 N*m class NEMA 23 brake (price/rating to verify) |
| D rail-SCARA | X rail (belt) | 12.2 kg at 1 m/s^2 | 0.29 | 1.5 | 20 % | move ≤70 % | OK | NEMA 23 closed loop + HTD 5M belt on HGR20 rail |

- D: J1 inertia at full stretch 0.800 kg·m², α 5.6 rad/s²; J2 inertia 0.180 kg·m²; wrist inertia with plate 0.040 kg·m².
- D: gravity bending moment into the J1 bearing and column: **14.4 N·m** (carried by a bearing pair, never by a motor).
- D: column tilt drop at the tool (4040, assumed Ix): 0.6 mm at plate height (0.35 m), 1.8 mm at AMS height (1.0 m). Static and repeatable: calibrate per payload, stiffen column in Phase 2.
- C: cantilever moment on the telescoping Y carriage 9.1 N·m at 0.45 m extension.
- Scale check from the brief: 1.2 kg held 0.5 m out = 5.9 N·m = 60 kg·cm ≈ 33 SG90s at stall.
